remainingParentGaps: No complete whole-service executable profile exists: RSS/native-memory, admin, explanation, scheduler queue/subscriber/channel, retained generations, snapshot and all byte/age relationships remain outside this HTTP-only block.

The specification candidate envelope 30+2 handlers and 60+4 burst/30+2 rate is not the same as all currently admissible custom HTTP configurations (existing max handler sum is 256, burst/rate sums lack explicit envelope relations). This block proves the existing selected envelope only, not the candidate production capacity.

Scheduler defaults/documented implementation use 32 global jobs, 64 subscribers and 512 channels; the candidate specification describes per-lane queues 8/2/1, 128 global subscribers and 64 channels. Choosing/reconciling those values is outside TCFG02.
Control deployment is optional (--control-port=0 disables it), so nonzero profile control_handlers does not establish an actual running diagnostic listener.
No global initial-state theorem for random service generations, shared process-budget ownership, OS handles or prewarmed workers is established by the isolated Admission projection.

Independent observation schemas, disclosure semantics, full backend/worker refinement, deadlines after floating-point clock arithmetic, reachability/event lifecycle and deployment/proxy/host bounds remain OPEN.
